claim.quote: the exclusion upper limit of the WIMP-nucleon cross section 4.3$\times$10$^{-41}$cm$^2$ at 8 GeV/c$^2$ was obtained and we exclude almost all the DAMA/LIBRA allowed region in the 6 to 16 GeV/c$^2$ range at $\sim$10$^{-40}$cm$^2$

key_value.note: WIMP-nucleon exclusion upper limit at 8 GeV/c^2.

name: Direct dark matter search by annual modulation in XMASS-I

summary.plain: XMASS looked for the yearly rise and fall in dark matter signals that another experiment (DAMA/LIBRA) has claimed, saw a slightly negative effect instead, and excluded most of the DAMA/LIBRA-allowed region for WIMPs elastically scattering on xenon.
summary.technical: 359.2 live days x 832 kg between November 2013 and March 2015. WIMP-nucleon limit 4.3e-41 cm^2 at 8 GeV/c^2; the model-independent modulation analysis showed a slight negative amplitude with p-values 0.014 and 0.068 for the null hypothesis (two analyses).

title: Direct dark matter search by annual modulation in XMASS-I
why_it_matters: The abstract describes it as the first extensive annual-modulation search probing this region with an exposure comparable to DAMA/LIBRA.
